listingTitle: Avoid shifting JavaScript arrays in loops
title: Avoid shifting JavaScript arrays in loops
why: Array.shift moves every remaining element, so repeatedly consuming an array from the front can produce quadratic work.
suggestion: Advance an index through the array or use a deque implementation for front-removal semantics.
limitations: Only variables with an array type annotation or array-literal assignment shifted inside braced loops are reported.
Aliases, reassignment, collection size, and bounded loop counts are not inferred.

Loop/function structure and declaration evidence use masked executable source; comment, string and regex literal text does not establish a collection or structural scope. Analysis remains lexical rather than type-resolved.
